description: This file defines a React component named DynamicTable that dynamically renders tabular data from an array of objects, with support for nested objects and various data types. It includes helper functions for flattening nested objects and collecting unique column keys from data items.

methods.name: isPlainObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a plain object (excluding arrays and null).

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested object into a single-level object with dot notation keys.

methods.name: collectColumns
methods.description: Collects and sorts all unique keys from a list of objects, considering nested object properties.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a value into a React node, handling null, undefined, arrays, objects, booleans, dates, and other primitives.
